name: Kazama Chikage
source:
A mysterious Third Year, Form Three student and the president of the Student Council. In spite of being an university graduate, he enrolls in Hakuou Academy. He's a former university classmate of Hijikata and is not on good terms. He makes full use of his authority in the Student Council, owning most of the property in the Student Council's room and wears a custom-made uniform.

[From [url=http://hakuouki.wikia.com/wiki/Hakuouki_SSL]wikia[/url]]
